quests.title: Molecular Architect Challenge
quests.description: Design and build molecular structures using advanced bonding theories!

story.introduction: The Molecular Design Institute needs your expertise! Use your knowledge of chemical bonding to design stable molecular structures.

steps.title: VSEPR Theory Application
steps.narrative: Professor Molecule challenges you to predict molecular shapes using VSEPR theory.

problem.question: What is the molecular geometry of NH₃ (ammonia)?
problem.explanation: NH₃ has 3 bonding pairs and 1 lone pair around nitrogen, giving it a trigonal pyramidal shape according to VSEPR theory.
